key.name: enabled
key.description: Master toggle to activate or deactivate the entire Sylepsign signage subsystem.

key.name: enable-gdm-signage
key.description: Whether video signage should play on the login/greeter screen when no user is logged in.

key.name: enable-user-lockscreen
key.description: Whether to bypass the standard user lock screen on idle/lock and redirect directly to the GDM signage greeter.

key.name: playback-order
key.description: Order in which videos are queued and played ('random', 'sequential', 'alphabetical').

key.name: playback-speed
key.description: Multiplier for video playback rate (e.g. 0.5 for half speed, 1.0 for normal, 2.0 for double speed).

key.name: hwdec-mode
key.description: mpv hardware video decoding accelerator ('auto', 'no', 'vaapi', 'nvdec').

key.name: vo-driver
key.description: mpv video output driver ('auto', 'gpu', 'gpu-next', 'dmabuf-wayland', 'wlshm').

key.name: multi-monitor-mode
key.description: Multi-monitor video presentation mode ('different' to play a different video on each screen, 'mirror' to clone across all screens).

key.name: video-fit
key.description: How videos fit on each screen ('cover' to fill and crop edges, 'fill' to letterbox, 'stretch' to ignore aspect ratio).

key.name: inhibit-screen-sleep
key.description: Prevent the display from sleeping via DPMS while video signage is playing.

key.name: chrome-fade-idle-seconds
key.summary: Greeter chrome fade delay in seconds
key.description: Seconds of inactivity in GDM greeter before login UI fades to reveal full video.

key.name: chrome-fade-duration-ms
key.description: Duration of the greeter UI fade animation in milliseconds.

key.name: chrome-fade-min-opacity
key.description: Target opacity percentage for the login controls when idle faded (0 for invisible, or semi-translucent ambient).

key.name: dim-alpha
key.description: Opacity percentage of the dark tint behind login controls (0 to 100).

key.name: dim-color
key.description: Hex color used for the backdrop tint behind login controls.

key.name: greeter-logo-path
key.description: Path to the deployed system-wide greeter logo image.

key.name: minutes-after-idle
key.description: Minutes of user inactivity before screen locks and video signage activates.

key.name: enable-http-server
key.description: Toggle whether this machine serves its video pool to other workstations over HTTP/mDNS.

key.name: http-port
key.description: Port used by the embedded HTTP server to distribute signage assets.

key.name: enable-mdns-publish
key.description: Whether to advertise this machine's pool service via Avahi mDNS on the LAN.

key.name: enable-mesh
key.description: Toggle whether this machine automatically discovers peers and adopts signage videos.

key.name: trickle-interval-minutes
key.description: How often this machine pulls a new video asset from available network peers for adoption.

key.name: max-cache
key.description: Maximum number of adopted videos retained in the local cache.

key.name: bootstrap-min
key.summary: Minimum videos to adopt on bootstrap
key.description: Minimum video assets adopted on startup if the local collection is empty.

key.name: connect-timeout-seconds
key.description: Timeout in seconds for peer catalog and probe HTTP requests.
